skill.name: frontend-design
skill.description: Create distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces with high design quality. Use this skill when the user asks to build web components, pages, or applications. Generates creative, polished code that avoids generic AI aesthetics.
skill.summary: Guide AI tools to create distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces with strong aesthetic direction.
skill.author: AdamAugustinsky

security_audit.summary: Reviewed SKILL.md and found the static system-reconnaissance matches to be false positives on frontend design prose. The skill contains instruction-only design guidance, with no scripts, network access, file access requests, prompt injection text, or data exfiltration intent.

finding_verdicts.reason: The line describes frontend interface design goals and asks for working UI code. It does not request host, account, network, or environment reconnaissance.
The line gives typography guidance, including font choices to avoid. No system probing, data collection, or reconnaissance behavior is requested.
The line lists visual background effects for CSS styling. It does not ask the model to inspect the system or collect environment details.

content.value_statement: Generic generated interfaces can feel repetitive and weakly tailored. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code toward bold, polished frontend work with clear aesthetic direction.
actual_capabilities: Guides selection of a clear aesthetic direction before implementation.
Encourages production-grade HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, or Vue interfaces.
Provides direction for typography, color, motion, layout, and visual detail.
Pushes context-specific design choices instead of generic AI patterns.
Balances maximalist and minimalist approaches based on the product goal.
limitations: Does not include executable scripts, components, or design assets.
Does not perform accessibility testing or browser compatibility checks by itself.
Depends on the host AI model to implement the requested frontend correctly.
May need project-specific design system rules from the user for brand accuracy.

use_cases.title: Create a Product Page
use_cases.description: Turn a product brief into a distinctive, responsive page with strong typography, color, motion, and visual hierarchy.

use_cases.title: Upgrade an App Screen
use_cases.description: Improve an existing interface with clearer layout, stronger interaction states, and a more memorable visual direction.

use_cases.title: Explore Design Directions
use_cases.description: Generate several frontend concepts that match different tones, audiences, and brand constraints before implementation.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Simple Page
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a new web page.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a responsive page for [product]. Use a bold visual direction, distinctive typography, and production-ready frontend code.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Dashboard
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for an application interface.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design and implement a dashboard for [audience]. Include [data types], efficient workflows, polished layout, and subtle motion.

prompt_templates.title: Improve Existing UI
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for redesigning current work.
prompt_templates.prompt: Transform this existing component: [component]. Preserve behavior, improve layout, color, typography, and interactions, and explain the design decisions.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Full Frontend Concept
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for a complete app experience.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a frontend concept for [app] in [framework]. Include responsive states, accessible controls, refined animations, and a cohesive design system.

output_examples.input: A request for a SaaS onboarding dashboard.
output_examples.output: A responsive dashboard concept with compact navigation, clear activity panels, restrained motion, and a distinctive visual system.

output_examples.input: A request to refresh a pricing page.
output_examples.output: A redesigned pricing experience with stronger plan comparison, memorable typography, confident color, and clear purchase actions.

output_examples.input: A request for a creative portfolio homepage.
output_examples.output: A polished homepage direction with expressive layout, curated motion, project highlights, and details that match the creator's style.

best_practices: Provide the audience, product goal, brand constraints, and preferred framework.
Ask for responsive behavior and accessibility requirements when they matter.
Review generated designs against real content, not placeholder text.
anti_patterns: Asking for a vague page without audience, content, or interaction details.
Using the skill to override an existing design system without approval.
Accepting visual polish without testing keyboard, screen reader, and mobile behavior.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It guides AI tools to create more distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces with stronger aesthetic choices.

faq.question: Does it write frontend code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill asks the host AI model to implement working HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Vue, or similar frontend code.

faq.question: Can it follow an existing brand system?
faq.answer: Yes, when you provide brand rules, design tokens, visual examples, and product context in the prompt.

faq.question: Does it replace a designer?
faq.answer: No. It helps generate and refine interface concepts, but human review remains important for brand, accessibility, and usability.

faq.question: How should I prompt it?
faq.answer: Describe the audience, goal, content, constraints, framework, and desired tone. Add examples when you need a specific style.

faq.question: Is this skill safe to install?
faq.answer: The reviewed package contains only SKILL.md guidance. It does not include scripts, network calls, or executable assets.
